mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the pineal gland made the pathway meaningful: the planned day–night comparison shows increased nighttime melatonin and suppression by light at night.

leastWorthwhile.text: The initial attempt to attach the retinal cells directly to the body yielded only incompatibility feedback; it did not explain why the pathway had to be assembled separately.

surprise.text: The outgoing pathway takes an indirect route through the spinal cord and a nerve cluster in the neck before reaching the pineal gland.

arbitrary.text: The required order of assembling the pathway before attaching it to the body felt somewhat arbitrary, even though the resulting connections had a clear purpose.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: the pathway linked a familiar daily rhythm to an unexpectedly indirect anatomical route, though I would want more explanation of how the clock coordinates other organs.
